name: Dirty Fantasies: The Good Deed
source:
This story will immerse you in the ordinary everyday days of a young girl. One day she decided to finish work early and go for a walk. On it, she saw a dog in a collar, but did not find the owner nearby. She decided to help find him. The owner was found quickly and as a reward for a good deed, invited the girl to dinner. How will their date end?

[From [url=https://fallen-pie.itch.io/dirty-fantasies-the-good-deed]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个故事将带你沉浸在一个年轻女孩的平凡日常生活中。有一天，她决定早点结束工作去散步。在上面，她看到了一只项圈里的狗，但在附近却没有找到主人。她决定帮忙找到他。很快就找到了失主，并作为善行的奖励，邀请女孩共进晚餐。他们的约会将如何结束？

[来自[url=https://fallen-pie.itch.io/dirty-fantasies-the-good-deed]Itch.io[/url]]
